diagnosis: Account is in eu-central, where private networking is not yet available, so the request stays queued instead of failing. The entitlement is present on the premium tier, so this is a regional availability limitation, not an entitlement issue.
reply: Thank you for reaching out. Your account has the private networking entitlement, but your account's region, eu-central, is not yet supported for private networking. Per our knowledge base, private networking is currently available in us-east, us-west and eu-west, and requests in unsupported regions remain queued rather than failing, which is why your request has stayed in a queued state. I have recommended this ticket for escalation to a specialist.
